LAKEWOOD, Colo., Sept. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Natural Grocers®, the nation's largest family-operated organic and natural retailer, invites customers to its annual
celebration with monthlong savings for {N}power® members, special offers Sept. 17–19, organic-focused community education and an in-store fundraiser benefiting
Natural Grocers® celebrates Organic Month with exclusive savings and organic education.
A SIMPLE PHILOSOPHY TO CELEBRATE

"At Natural Grocers, our philosophy is simple: food should come from natural sources and undergo as few modifications as possible," said Raquel Isely, vice president of marketing at Natural Grocers. "We only carry 100% organic produce, and the products we carry on our shelves and in our coolers have been carefully selected to meet our rigorous standards, which prioritize ingredient transparency and exclude numerous additives and ingredients commonly found in conventional grocery products.

"Organic Month is a chance to celebrate the quality products on our shelves, the practices behind them and the vendors who provide them. It's also an opportunity to help folks discover why and how choosing organic makes a difference. We encourage our customers to read labels, look for the USDA Organic Seal and choose organic when possible because informed consumers make better choices for their health, the health of their communities and the health of our food system."

ABOUT NATURAL GROCERS BY VITAMIN COTTAGE
Founded in 1955, Natural Grocers by Vitamin Cottage, Inc. (

) is an expanding specialty retailer of natural and organic groceries, body care products and dietary supplements. The grocery products sold by Natural Grocers must meet strict quality guidelines and may not contain artificial flavors, preservatives or sweeteners (as defined by its standards), synthetic colors or partially hydrogenated or hydrogenated oils. The Company sells only USDA-certified organic produce and exclusively pasture-raised, non-confinement dairy products and free-range eggs. Natural Grocers' flexible smaller-store format allows it to offer affordable prices in a shopper-friendly, clean and convenient retail environment. The Company also provides extensive free science-based Nutrition Education programs to help customers and Crew make informed health and nutrition choices. Natural Grocers is committed to its Five Founding Principles—including its "Commitment to Community" and "Commitment to Crew." In fiscal year 2025, the Company invested more than $16 million in incremental compensation and discretionary payments for Crew. Headquartered in Lakewood, CO, Natural Grocers has 174 stores in 22 states. Visit naturalgrocers.com for more information and store locations.
